#!/usr/bin/env bash
# as scripts/x.sh
# A spike call without the guards (the owner, "spikes: b": every agent-messaging call ends with them).
printf x | sudo -n -u "$agent" -- /usr/bin/env -i HOME="/home/$agent" PATH=/usr/bin:/bin \
    claude -p --max-budget-usd "$SPIKE_CALL_BUDGET" --input-format stream-json --output-format stream-json --verbose --max-turns 2 --permission-mode dontAsk > "$out2" 2>&1 &
